visual_findings.observation: Silver/ivory abdomen narrows at the top and widens/flairs at its lower edge; small dark head with two warm eyes is separate below. Bent limbs radiate on both sides. The body reads as a silk-bell spider rather than the previously reported brown oval/beetle/pod. Silver regional color is allowed by the Bible and is not rejected merely for differing from shared bronze.

visual_findings.observation: Four mirrored limb pairs can be traced through separated distal branches in the enlarged view: upper side arches, middle outward/down legs, lower diagonals and long inner downward pair. Approximate left/right tips lie near(2,14)/(29,14), (2,21)/(29,21), (4,26)/(27,26), (11,29)/(20,29) in the32px grid. They attach into the body/head; no separate floating limb parts were seen. At native size on a dark field, the darkest1px segments are weak and eight individually countable legs are not yet a scene-approved result.

Native contours and stepped bends are deliberate, with no soft resampling halo visible. The bright upper-left/left sac edge and darker central/right/lower facets provide some common light direction and dark underside. The sac has much broader, flatter facets than the finely lit shared patrol/charger/merchant; this contact board does not establish full material/style equality.
